issues.location: initial-segment comparison lemma proof, source lines 130–135
issues.finding: The proof ends by saying f's domain is B_{b_2}, although it earlier defines f from A_{a_2} to B_{b_2}. The inference b_1 < b_2 uses the range/codomain B_{b_2}, not the domain.
issues.proposed_resolution: Say that the range of the isomorphism f is B_{b_2} in the translated proof and bounded comparison view, preserving its displayed map and every mathematical symbol.

translation_treatment: Translated the entire isomorphism development, including uniqueness, initial segments and comparability, with 'jangkauan' for the misnamed range. The English plural s attached to the glossary token for bijection is removed only in the comparison view to permit Javanese grammar without losing the token. Frozen source bytes are unchanged.
